What this means for your data
Data generated with this tool belongs to you. It is not a derived work, and the license of this tool does not cover it.
Every value this tool produces is synthetic and is generated for testing. Names, addresses, identifiers and account numbers do not describe anybody. Where a
value resembles a real person, company or institution, that is a coincidence of arithmetic rather than a record of anything, and it must not be treated as one.
